findings.title: Email trim/lower-case not stated for createEditorSchema and the CLI (only loginStep1Schema)
findings.fix: Shared emailSchema = z.string().trim().toLowerCase().pipe(z.email().max(254)) used by login, createEditor and the CLI; unit test ' Bob@Example.ORG ' -> 'bob@example.org'.

findings.title: Order of operations for sealing TOTP with AAD totp:<id> before the cuid id is known is unspecified
findings.fix: In one transaction: create with totpSecretEnc null/totpEnabled false, then update with seal(secret, `totp:${user.id}`) and totpEnabled true (CLI, --reset, e2e-prepare).

findings.title: E2E: "1" in webServer.env has no defined consumer
findings.fix: Remove it, or state its single use and add a static check that no file under src/ reads process.env.E2E.

findings.title: IP rate-limit key trusts x-forwarded-for; the Vercel-only trust assumption is undocumented
findings.fix: Document in §7.2 and the README security notes that the IP key relies on Vercel overwriting x-forwarded-for; account lockout is the primary control.

findings.title: First Neon deploy can prerender an empty home page before seeding
findings.fix: README order: db:deploy -> db:seed -> admin:create-owner, then the first deploy (or Redeploy after seeding).

findings.title: Exact Cache-Control: no-store assertion may fail because Next sets its own Cache-Control on dynamic responses
findings.fix: E2E asserts cache-control contains 'no-store'; the other headers exactly.

findings.title: Meaning of an empty publishedAt on update is undefined
findings.fix: Form always pre-fills publishedAt; empty on update = keep stored value; only a stored null becomes now on publish; unit test that the date is unchanged.
